description: Use this when a song should move between MTL text, a Moose Tracker .mtk project, a share link and standard files: MIDI (.mid) and MOD, XM, S3M or IT tracker modules, in either direction (files in as base64; a written file comes back as a download link). It takes a song into another program (a DAW, a notation app, another tracker) or brings one in; voices maps channels to sample packs or presets on import, and feel adds swing or humanize. Cues and macros are compiled away in .mtk and share links. Schema 2d544474.

input.description: The song, .mtk JSON or share link; for mid, mod, xm, s3m and it, the file as base64 (up to about 700 KB)

name: convert
title: Convert song formats
